title: West Pakistan Foodstuffs Control Sindh Amendment Act 1973

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Foodstuffs Control Sindh Amendment Act 1973
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT V OF 1973
ACT V OF 1973
WEST PAKISTAN
FOODSTUFFS (CONTROL) (SIND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1973
An Act to amend
the West Pakistan Foodstuffs (Control) Act, 1958 to its application to the
Province of Sind
[Gazette of Sind,
Extraordinary, Part IV, 29th June 1973]
(First published after having
received the assent of the Governor of Sind in the Gazette of Sind
(Extraordinary), dated 28th June 1973).
No. PAS/Legis-B-5/73.---The
West Pakistan Foodstuffs (Control (Sind Amendment) Bill, 1973, having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sind on the 5th June 1973, and assented to
by the Governor of Sind on the 27th June 1973 is hereby published as an Act, of
the Legislature of Sind :-
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the West Pakistan Foodstuffs (Control)
(Sind Amendment) Act, 1973.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Foodstuffs Control Sindh Amendment Act 1973
sections.description:
Substitution of section 10 of West Pakistan Act XX of 1958

ACT V OF 1973
ACT V OF 1973
WEST PAKISTAN
FOODSTUFFS (CONTROL) (SIND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1973
An Act to amend
the West Pakistan Foodstuffs (Control) Act, 1958 to its application to the
Province of Sind
[Gazette of Sind,
Extraordinary, Part IV, 29th June 1973]
(First published after having
received the assent of the Governor of Sind in the Gazette of Sind
(Extraordinary), dated 28th June 1973).
No. PAS/Legis-B-5/73.---The
West Pakistan Foodstuffs (Control (Sind Amendment) Bill, 1973, having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sind on the 5th June 1973, and assented to
by the Governor of Sind on the 27th June 1973 is hereby published as an Act, of
the Legislature of Sind :-
3. Substitution of section 10
of West Pakistan Act XX of 1958.---For section 10 of the said Act, the
following section shall be substituted, namely :-
"10. Cognizance
of offences and mode of trial.-(1) No Court shall take cognizance of any
offence punishable under this Act except on a report. In writing if the facts
constituting such offence, made by a person who is a public servant as defined
in section 21 of the Pakistan Penal Code (Act XLV of 1860).
(2) Government
may, by notification, direct that all or any of the offences or class of
offences shall be tried in summary way in accordance with the procedure
prescribed by Chapter XXII of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898 (Act V of
1898)."
sections.punishment: punishable under this Act except on a report.
